title: Design: No Charge categories tab shows Original work order Required or Not asked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-05-2b-internal-work-orders-page-no-charge-categories.png, iwo-happy-05-05-no-charge-categories.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Click the No Charge categories tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Internal categories tab is shown first.

Step 2:

  • The tab becomes selected and a blue "New No Charge Category" button sits at the right above the table.
  • The columns read, in order: Category, QuickBooks expense account, Original work order, Work orders, row menu.
  • Warranty and Comeback show "Required" and Goodwill shows "Not asked" in the Original work order column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R13: “No Charge categories: Category, QuickBooks expense account, Original work order (Required / Not asked), Work orders, row menu.”
  • S1-R13: “The starting set is seeded for every organization when this release ships, so the categories, the QuickBooks rows (S5-R5) and the hub rows (S6-R2) exist before the setting is turned on; turning the setting on seeds nothing: General Internal (default, cannot be archived); Warranty (requires the original work order), Goodwill (does not), Comeback (requires).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
